Rift, a fast file manager for Windows with tabs and side-by-side panes. This release adds a graphical drive usage scanner.

## Download

- **`Rift-win-Setup.exe`**: installs Rift for your user (no admin rights, no .NET needed). Already have 0.9 or 0.10? It updates itself.
- **`Rift-win-Portable.zip`**: runs from any folder, no install, and updates itself too.

The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

## New in 0.11

- Graphical disk usage scanner: click the chart icon next to Drives in the sidebar, right-click a drive in the sidebar or This PC ("Analyze disk usage"), or run it from the Command Palette (`Ctrl+K`)
- Interactive donut chart with color-coded space breakdown: free space (green), apps & binaries (yellow), media, archives & images, documents & code, other files, and system/inaccessible remainder
- Switch between drives, toggle whole drive vs. used space only, sort categories by size, file count, or name, and stop or rescan at any time while scanning in the background

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
